changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, code, description) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, 'portal.staff.request', 'Request a staff invitation into your own branch; it is sent only once a company-wide approver approves it.'); INSERT INTO role_permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, role_id, permission_id) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, r.id, p.id FROM roles r, permissions p WHERE r.code IN ('branch_manager', 'executive_director') AND p.code = 'portal.staff.request';
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE permission_id IN (SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE code = 'portal.staff.request'); DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code = 'portal.staff.request';
